title: VPN error gateway not reachable
symptoms: Several users could not connect to GlobalProtect and saw gateway not reachable after ISP maintenance.
root_cause: DNS cache retained an outdated gateway address.
resolution: Flush DNS cache, restart GlobalProtect and validate portal vpn.ragzor.local.

title: SAP user missing display role
symptoms: User could log in to SAP but could not display purchase orders.
root_cause: Display role MM_VIEWER was not assigned after approval.
resolution: Assign approved role and ask user to restart SAP session.

title: Password reset blocked by unavailable MFA
symptoms: User forgot password and could not approve MFA because the phone was replaced.
resolution: Validate identity, remove old MFA method and trigger new registration.

title: VPN MFA required loop
symptoms: VPN repeatedly requested MFA and did not complete connection.
root_cause: Authenticator push notifications were disabled on the mobile device.
resolution: Enable notifications, remove stale login attempts and reconnect.

title: User cannot access Teams after password change
symptoms: Teams desktop client kept requesting credentials after password reset.
root_cause: Cached credentials in Windows Credential Manager.
resolution: Remove cached Office credentials and sign in again.

title: SAP account locked after failed attempts
symptoms: User reported SAP login blocked after multiple attempts.
root_cause: Incorrect saved password in SAP GUI.
resolution: Unlock SAP user, clear saved credential and confirm corporate password.

title: Internal HR portal access denied
symptoms: New collaborator could not open HR portal.
root_cause: Onboarding ticket did not include HR_BASIC profile.
resolution: Request manager approval and add HR_BASIC profile.

title: VPN disconnects every 10 minutes
symptoms: Remote users disconnected regularly while connected through public Wi-Fi.
root_cause: Unstable network and outdated VPN client.
resolution: Upgrade GlobalProtect client and test from stable network.

title: Azure portal requires additional verification
symptoms: Administrator was asked for additional verification when opening Azure portal.
root_cause: Conditional Access policy required MFA for privileged access.
resolution: Confirm policy behavior and complete MFA with approved method.

title: Account locked after repeated login failures
symptoms: User account locked in the morning after failed attempts overnight.
root_cause: Mobile mail client retained an old password.
resolution: Update password on mobile mail client and monitor sign-in logs.

title: SAP role request pending approval
symptoms: User asked why SAP access was not active after submitting a ticket.
resolution: Notify manager and resume provisioning after approval.

title: Multiple VPN failures after certificate renewal
symptoms: Users received certificate validation errors during VPN login.
root_cause: Intermediate certificate was not installed on some laptops.
resolution: Deploy certificate chain through device management and retry.

title: MFA registration not completed during onboarding
symptoms: New employee could not access VPN on first remote day.
root_cause: MFA setup task was skipped during induction.
resolution: Guide user through MFA registration and validate VPN access.

title: Finance app profile mismatch
symptoms: Approver could view requests but not approve them.
root_cause: Read-only profile assigned instead of approver profile.

title: SharePoint access request missing owner approval
symptoms: User could not access a department SharePoint site.
root_cause: Site owner had not approved the access request.
resolution: Route approval to site owner and grant group membership.

title: VPN slow after successful connection
symptoms: User connected to VPN but internal applications loaded slowly.
root_cause: Local network packet loss above acceptable threshold.
resolution: Test wired connection and collect latency evidence before escalation.

title: SAP transaction unavailable for new role
symptoms: User had SAP access but transaction ME23N was unavailable.
root_cause: Requested profile did not include purchasing display transaction.
resolution: Open role change request with justification and manager approval.

title: Suspicious password reset attempts
symptoms: User received unexpected password reset notifications.
resolution: Reset password, review sign-in logs and require MFA revalidation.
